jarvis2016_total_brain.title: Jarvis et al. 2016 total brain volume
jarvis2016_total_brain.citation: Jarvis D et al. Quantification of total fetal brain volume using 3D MR imaging data acquired in utero. Prenat Diagn. 2016;36:1225-1232.
jarvis2016_total_brain.note: Published coefficients are rounded; the paper's weekly prediction table is more numerically precise. Mean curve only: coefficients do not define centiles.
